name: Gutenberg Bible
description: The first substantial book printed with movable metal type in Europe, in an edition of about 180; some 49 copies survive. Its typography set the standard the manuscript age could not match in speed or price.

name: Mona Lisa
description: Leonardo's portrait of Lisa del Giocondo, celebrated for its sfumato modelling and elusive expression; its 1911 theft from the Louvre made it the world's most famous painting.
